quests.name: Chapter 7: A Voice Behind the Door
objectives: Enter the Braveheart Grove .
Look around and explore the Braveheart Grove .

Looks like someone is inside that House !
  ‧ Remove the corrupted Honey Swirls around Piglet's House. (3)
Knock on Piglet's door to see if anyone is home.
Ask Winnie the Pooh what might help Piglet feel safe.

Gather Ingredients to make Rabbit's Garden Pie and Blustery Day Soup for Piglet :
  ‧ Golden Pattypan. Parsnip. Pufflebud Pods. Carrot. Wheat. Golden Honey. Tree Resin. Mushroom. Truffle.

Cook comfort food for Piglet :
  ‧ Rabbit's Garden Pie. Blustery Day Soup.
Make sure you have Rabbit's Garden Pie and Blustery Day Soup in your Inventory.
Bring comfort food to Piglet .

Gather Ingredients to make the Door Grease :
  ‧ Catch Acorn Snail. (3) Gather Truffle. (3)
Make the Door Grease on the Crafting Station.
Make sure you have the Door Grease in your Inventory.
Bring Door Grease to Piglet .
Enter Piglet's House .
Talk to Piglet .

Take pictures to show Piglet the Woods are safe:
  ‧ Piglet's broom outside his House. Glowing lanterns around the Braveheart Grove (you need to water them first). (3)
Show the pictures to Piglet inside his House to prove the Woods are safe.
Go outside with Piglet .
Talk to Piglet outside.

quests.name: Chapter 8: The Little Big Forest
objectives: Talk to Piglet .
Follow Piglet to check if the Woods sounds are missing.
Follow Piglet to where the sounds went silent.

Gather materials to craft the Chime Arch and Buzzing Hive Cluster :
  ‧ Sweet Chestnut. (5) Oak Leaves. (6) Soft Limestone. (5) Yellow & Orange Foxglove. (5) Yellow Thistle. (3) Tree Resin. (5) Golden Honey. (8) Honey Agate. (4)

Craft the sounds of the Woods:
  ‧ Chime Arch. Buzzing Hive Cluster.

Place the sounds of the Woods anywhere in Braveheart Grove :
  ‧ Chime Arch. Buzzing Hive Cluster.
Talk to Piglet .
Follow Piglet to the last missing sound.
Talk to Piglet about his feelings and the place that helps him feel better.
Follow Piglet to his special spot.
Search for Very Important Instructions in Piglet's House .

Gather Ingredients for the Prickle-Popper Potion to upgrade your Shovel.
  ‧ Rose & Cream Foxglove. (5) Purple & White Foxglove. (5) Driftwood. (5) Shiny Honey Agate. (2) Truffle. (5)
Craft the Prickle-Popper Potion .
Use the Prickle-Popper Potion from your Inventory.
Clear the Twistroots around the Babbling Pond . (4)
Talk to Piglet about restoring the Babbling Pond in the Braveheart Grove .

Gather materials to fix the broken Babbling Pond .
  ‧ Soft Limestone. (15) Tree Resin. (10) Driftwood. (10) Honey Agate. (4) Oak Leaves. (10)
Interact with the Babbling Pond in the Braveheart Grove to begin repairing it.
Pick up the Mysterious Note near the Babbling Pond in the Braveheart Grove .
What was that?! Talk to Piglet and friends about what just happened.
Visit the entrance to the Everoak Tree in the Braveheart Grove .
Talk to Piglet near the Everoak Tree.

quests.name: Chapter 9: How to Meet a Best Friend (Again)
objectives: Talk to Piglet and friends about the Everoak Tree.
Look around the Grove to find the missing paints . You can start near the river.
Looks like Piglet has found something.
Use the Pink Watercolor on the canvas near the Everoak Tree.
Talk to Piglet .
Follow the paint trail to catch the paint thief. (10)
Looks like the trail is leading inside Piglet's House .
Ask Eeyore about the paint trail.
Use the Blue Watercolor on the canvas near the Everoak Tree.
Talk to Piglet .
Talk to Winnie the Pooh and ask if he found anything.

Take pictures of the places Winnie the Pooh visited while searching for the paint:
  ‧ A big waterfall with acorns near Piglet's House. A sturdy bridge where you first played Pooh Sticks. A broken bridge between Drowsybloom Acre and Braveheart Grove.
Show Winnie the Pooh the pictures you took.
Follow Winnie the Pooh .
Talk to Winnie the Pooh about the broken bridge.

Gather materials to repair the Shortcut Bridge .
  ‧ Tree Resin. (10) Driftwood. (10) Soft Limestone. (10) Golden Honey. (5)
Talk to Winnie the Pooh . He may have found something important .
Interact with the Shortcut Bridge to begin repairing it.
Talk to Piglet about the rebuilt bridge.
Welcome Piglet to the Honeyglow Woods .

quests.name: Interlude 3: The Shadowy Surprise
objectives: Follow Piglet to the Everoak Tree.
Add the Yellow Watercolor to the Art-full Place.
Enter the Everoak Tree from the Braveheart Grove .

Explore this hollow space inside the Everoak Tree.
  ‧ Check the note next to the alcove.
The alcove is empty. Ask Piglet if he knows where the Sun-Glow Honeypot is.
Continue heading downstairs.
Talk to Piglet about how to get past this room.
Solve the puzzle to open the door.
Talk to Piglet about this rather dark room.
Water the Honeyglow Lantern to light the room.
Those eerie shadows must have scared Piglet ! Make sure he's okay.
Take pictures of the shadows on the walls: (3)
Show Piglet the photos you took.
Collect Honeypots from around the room to block the shadows. (4)
Find a place on the rings for each honeypot.
Use the handles around the rings to turn them and complete the picture.
The shadows have changed! Talk to Piglet about your progress.
Use your Royal Pickaxe to widen the crack in the wall.
Pick up the Sun-Glow Honeypot .
Talk to Piglet about your success.
Place the Sun-Glow Honeypot back in the Alcove where it belongs.

A Memory appeared. Pick it up.
  ‧ Interact with the Memory in the Everoak Tree.
Talk to Piglet about the Memory.
Step outside the Everoak Tree to see if the fog is gone.
The fog is still there! Talk to Piglet about it.
Follow Piglet to the bridge leading to the Nectar Apiary .
Restore the Bridge to reach the Nectar Apiary .
(Optional) Restore the Busy Bees' House in Braveheart Grove .
(Optional) Help Piglet by completing his first Friendship Quest .
(Optional) Add decor to Braveheart Grove .
